title: Persist tenant-visible capability drift in the canonical operational alert lifecycle

phases.objective: Persist platform-global tenant-visible capability drift through the existing operational_alerts lifecycle while projecting it safely into each tenant read without adding a tenant mutation route or duplicating alert storage.

e2e_journeys.actor: Platform Admin synchronizer followed by an authenticated tenant reader
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: One canonical tenant-visible capability-gap alert is persisted globally, repeated healthy syncs advance occurrence/last-seen state, disappearance resolves it with lifecycle evidence, degraded source reads cannot auto-resolve it, and tenant reads project the alert into their tenant scope without admin evidence.
steps: Read only tenant-visible rows from v_platform_capability_gaps and canonical capability/maturity views.
Map each capability+gap pair to one scope-independent operational alert key while preserving the existing safe remediation classification.
Persist through the existing operational_alerts synchronization transaction rather than a parallel table or direct side effect.
Increment occurrence_count only for this snapshot source while preserving authoritative aggregate-count behavior for existing sources.
Keep capability-drift alerts out of notification outbox until a governed tenant fan-out policy exists.
Auto-resolve a persisted capability-drift alert only when all sources are healthy and the canonical gap is no longer emitted.
Project a persisted global tenant-visible capability alert into the requesting tenant scope and strip admin_evidence from the tenant response.
assertions: Only exposure_scope=tenant capability gaps enter the persistent operational alert source.
The same capability+gap produces one stable global alert key across tenants and observation times.
Admin synchronization persists the capability alert with tenant_id=null; tenant reads project tenant_id to the authenticated tenant.
Tenant projection strips admin_evidence while Admin projection may retain bounded internal registry evidence.
Repeated capability-drift synchronization increments occurrence_count without changing aggregate-count semantics for other sources.
Capability-drift alerts do not enter notification outbox before an explicit fan-out policy exists.
A degraded or truncated capability source prevents stale-alert auto-resolution.
No new table, migration, tenant sync mutation route, provider call, managed repair execution, Production action, or secret read is introduced.
